changes.to: Confirmed by Zebra MODEX 2022 press release (payload 600 lb). Detailed specs only in Zebra-authored brochure hosted by resellers; dims/weight taken from that Zebra brochure (cssi.com copy) - treat as maker document on third-party host. Earlier 2020 Fetch brochure stated 500 lb payload. Re-checked 2026-11-17: no CartConnect500 product page exists on zebra.com any more (zebra.com/us/en/products/robotics.html returns 404; Zebra sold its robotics automation business - formerly Fetch Robotics - to Skild AI, closed 2026-03-27 per Zebra's 10-Q, so the Fetch/Zebra AMR product pages are gone), so the Zebra-authored AMR solution guide (2021, sampled above) stays the source. That guide's spec table gives max speed 1.5 m/s, ~9 h runtime, 2x SICK 30 m/275 deg scanners and 8x 3D cameras, now filled. CONFLICT kept in the record: the same guide's spec table prints 'Maximum Payload Weight 800 lb (362.9 kg)' while its body text and Zebra's 2022 press release say loads up to 600 lb (272 kg); 272 kg is stored.
